questions.question: Delmi Tucker set a database record (21/22 season, T20) with a value of 26. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Fastest 50 (by balls)', held by Delmi Tucker.

questions.question: At which ground did Anneke Bosch record their career-best innings (159*, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Centurion Park, against Titans on 2019/10/26.

questions.question: At which ground did Eastern Storm record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 90, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/12.

questions.question: Laura Wolvaardt became the first South African woman to reach 5,000 ODI runs. In how many innings did she reach the milestone, the second-fastest ever?
questions.explanation: Wolvaardt reached 5,000 ODI runs in 117 innings, second only to India's Smriti Mandhana (112 innings).
